title: Plan 1: Hudl-Jahresexport, EP/WP-Retraining und Scouting-Produkte
summary: Phased implementation plan (strand 1 of 2) to turn the Hudl yearly export into a reproducible data pipeline, retrain EP/WP models, and generate scouting/coaching reports.
scope: Hudl yearly export / data contract with video analyst
data ingest pipeline (src/flag_football_ep package, ingest CLI, canonical Parquet)
data validation checks (RESULT vocabulary, downs, yardline_50, drive IDs, score reconstruction)
EP/WP model retraining (GroupKFold split, calibration, feature candidates, model versioning)
coaching products (opponent tendency reports, own-efficiency EPA reports, decision charts, WP charts)
notes: German-language phased plan, no frontmatter or filename convention. Dominant signals are PRD-like: goals, explicit Nicht-Ziele (non-goals), success criterion (report generation < 10 min before tournaments), prioritized product list. Competing signals: SPEC-like contract details (RESULT tagging vocabulary, validation ranges, schema fields) and DOC-like prose/roadmap structure. Resolved to PRD per ambiguity rule since requirements/scope framing dominates; extraction should still capture the Phase 1.1/1.2 data-contract constraints as technical requirements.
